NIS2 · Directive (EU) 2022/2555

EU NIS2 Compliance Kit for mid-sized businesses.

NIS2 makes thousands of mid-sized companies responsible for cybersecurity, with management liability and 24-hour incident reporting. This kit turns the directive into a workspace you can actually run.

Directive (EU) 2022/2555

What's in the kit

  • Scope Checker — enter sector, headcount and turnover; a formula suggests essential, important or out of scope
  • Authority Directory — national law, authority, CSIRT and registration route for DE, AT, NL, BE, ES and HR, with official links
  • Governance & Management Board — approvals, oversight and training of the management body (Art. 20)
  • Control Register — the 10 minimum measures of Art. 21(2), each with owner, status and evidence
  • Risk Register, Supplier Register and Policy Library, linked to the controls
  • Incident Log — automatic 24 h / 72 h / 1-month NIS2 deadlines plus the 72 h GDPR breach deadline
  • Evidence Library and Training Tracker for audits and management training
  • Setup guide, incident reporting playbook and a ready-to-send supplier security questionnaire

The rules it covers

  • Scope and registration

    NIS2 covers medium-sized and large organisations in 18 sectors, sorted into essential and important entities. Most of them must register with their national authority.

  • Risk-management measures

    Art. 21(2) lists ten minimum measures, from risk analysis and incident handling to supply-chain security, encryption and access control.

  • Management and reporting

    The management body approves and oversees the measures and must be trained (Art. 20). Significant incidents: early warning within 24 hours, notification within 72 hours, final report within one month (Art. 23).

Made for

  • IT managers and compliance leads
  • Managing directors of companies in scope
  • Information security officers
  • Consultants who support SMEs

Questions about this kit

Does NIS2 apply to my company?
As a rule it applies to medium-sized and large organisations (from 50 employees or €10 million annual turnover) in the sectors listed in Annexes I and II, and to some entities regardless of size. The scope checker suggests essential, important or out of scope; the national law decides the details.
Is NIS2 already law in my country?
It depends on the country. The authority directory lists the national law and its status for Germany, Austria, the Netherlands, Belgium, Spain and Croatia, with official links. For Germany & Austria, the Netherlands, Spain and Croatia there are also localised editions of this kit.
Is there a Word or Excel edition?
Not yet. This kit is currently available as a Notion template only. The free Notion plan is enough: after purchase you click “Duplicate” and the kit is copied into your own workspace.
